claims.statement: The supplied summaries do not uniquely determine the theorem's height-boundary convention.

limitations: Absence is established only for the permitted directory at audit time, not for any historical or external location.
No source-level proof audit, compiler acceptance, declaration-dependency audit, or checker replay was possible.

The first boundary-probe serialization used labels that differ only by letter case and was rejected by PowerShell; distinct labels produced the exact boundary evaluation.
next_actions: Preserve the exact source, checker, immutable inputs, expected-count specification, digest manifest, pinned toolchain, dependency manifests, and claimed output in one self-contained bundle.

proposed_tasks.title: Preserve and replay the orbit-pruning bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Assemble a digest-identified source, toolchain, checker, input, and expected-output bundle and independently compile and replay it.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The present review cannot resolve machine acceptance or historical counts because every executable research artifact and its pinning metadata are absent.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: The identified source compiles under the pinned dependency set without unfinished proofs or extra axioms, its declaration matches a canonical contract, and the checker reproduces every documented count from identified inputs.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Record an exact digest mismatch, missing dependency, compiler error, trust-expanding declaration, theorem mismatch, input ambiguity, or count mismatch.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Verify the manifest and input digests, build in a clean pinned environment, inspect declaration dependencies, and compare deterministic checker output with the signed-off expected-count record.
